title: 第25章 天涯共此时第26章 第二灵宠
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
八阶灵兽？
楚少野有些惊讶，赤霄宗和祝余城都处在南部洲的西南角，地处荒僻，灵气贫乏。
就连祝余城城主和赤霄宗宗主也不过只是六阶的中阶灵主而已，如果不是在这偏远之地，仅凭这样的实力很难成为一个大势力的首领。
没想到赤霄宗中竟然还隐藏着一只八阶灵兽。
楚少野好奇问道：“任兄可知道，那只八阶灵兽是何种类？”
任生平嗐了一声，“我也是听老杂役弟子们说的，是不是真有还不知道呢。”
有任生平这个大胃王在，小半只烤铁皮蜥蜴很快被吃的干干净净，任生平打了个哈欠道：“楚兄弟，侯三的事值得说的就这么多，如今你已经进阶为二阶，不用过于担心，早点休息吧。”
楚少野应了一声，洗漱完后吹熄蜡烛，躺到床上休息。
他将双手枕在脑后，看着黑漆漆的屋顶，霜月曾经也是八阶的灵兽，不知道它现在怎么样了，旧伤可好了一些。
据霜月所说，它还是小奶狼的时候就跟他父亲契约了，跟着父亲走遍了万灵大陆，在受伤之前，霜月已经摸到了九阶的门槛，是个准圣兽。
可惜霜月受伤之后品阶大跌，它刚到楚家村的时候甚至只有四阶的实力，休养了这么多年，也才恢复到五阶而已。
五阶，对现在的楚少野来说已经是很厉害的存在了，在他的眼里，霜月就像是无所不能的，它不仅知道很多事情，实力也无比强大。
他难以想象如果是全盛时期的霜月，该是多么的威风凛凛。
希望霜月一切都好，他期待着与霜月的再次重聚。
南部洲的气候总体湿热，很少有冰属性的灵兽和灵植生存。
此时，一处地下溶洞中，凝结的水珠从倒悬的钟乳石上滑过，像一颗颗珍珠滴落到下方的寒潭中。
叮叮咚咚的声音在溶洞中回荡，寒潭的最中央，一株碧光寒莲亭亭玉立，散发出幽幽的青绿色荧光。
碧光寒莲，六阶灵植，通体如琉璃一般剔透晶莹，喜爱昏暗湿冷的环境，对冰属性灵兽来说是大补之物。
一双冰蓝色的眼睛在暗处闪现，庞大的身躯在地上走过却没有发出一丁点的响声。
这正是楚少野牵挂着的霜月，它低头在地面上闻了闻，并没有嗅到其他灵兽的味道。

高级灵植的周围一般都有守护灵兽，但是寒潭却可以遮盖灵兽的气息。
霜月并没有掉以轻心，它注意着周围，缓步走上了水面。
冰霜在脚底下凝结，顺着脚步的移动在水面上凝结出一条冰路。
就在霜月走到一半的时候，一团庞大的黑影在冰面底下滑过，霜月立时低头看过去。
就在它低头之时，一个黑影突然在冰路的左侧破水而出，掀起五米多高的水浪。
霜月反应迅速，凝结出一堵冰墙挡住了黑影的攻击。
借着碧光寒莲的荧光，黑影的本体显现出来，身形细长，两颊生鳃，体表光滑无鳞，四肢生有尖利的蹼爪。
content_en:
An eighth-level spirit beast?
Chu Shaoye was a little surprised. Both Chixiao Sect and Zhu Yucheng were located in the southwest corner of Nanzhou. They were in remote areas and lacked spiritual energy.
Even the Lord of Zhu Yu City and the Lord of Chixiao Sect are only sixth-level mid-level spiritual masters. If they were not in this remote place, it would be difficult to become the leader of a big force with such strength alone.
Unexpectedly, there is an eighth-level spiritual beast hidden in the Scarlet Sky Sect.
Chu Shaoye asked curiously: "Brother Ren, does he know what kind of eighth-level spiritual beast it is?"
Ren Shengping said, "I also heard it from the old handyman disciples. I don't know if it is true."
With Ren Shengping, a big eater, half of the grilled iron lizard was quickly eaten clean. Ren Shengping yawned and said, "Brother Chu, there is only so much to say about Hou San. Now that you have advanced to the second level, don't worry too much. Go to bed early."
Chu Shaoye responded. After washing, he blew out the candles and lay down on the bed to rest.
He put his hands behind his head and looked at the dark roof. Shuangyue was once an eighth-level spiritual beast. I don't know how it is doing now. The old injuries are better.
According to Shuangyue, it made a contract with his father when it was still a little milk wolf, and followed his father throughout the Wanling Continent. Before being injured, Shuangyue had already touched the threshold of the ninth level, and was a quasi-sacred beast.
It's a pity that Shuangyue's level dropped sharply after she was injured. When she first arrived in Chujia Village, she was only at level 4. After recuperating for so many years, she only returned to level 5.
The fifth level is already a very powerful existence for Chu Shaoye now. In his eyes, Shuangyue seems to be omnipotent. Not only does it know many things, it is also extremely powerful.
He could not imagine how majestic Frost Moon would be in its heyday.
He hoped that Shuangyue would be fine, and he looked forward to being reunited with Shuangyue again.
The climate in the southern continent is generally hot and humid, and few ice-type spiritual beasts and spiritual plants survive.
At this time, in an underground cave, condensed water droplets slid over the hanging stalactites, dripping like pearls into the cold pool below.
The sound of ding-ding-dong-dong echoed in the cave. In the center of the cold pool, a green lotus stood tall and graceful, emitting a faint green fluorescence.
Jade Light Cold Lotus is a sixth-level spiritual plant. Its whole body is as clear and crystal clear as glass. It likes dark, damp and cold environments. It is a great tonic for ice-attributed spiritual beasts.
A pair of ice-blue eyes flashed in the darkness, and the huge body walked across the ground without making the slightest sound.
This was the Shuangyue that Chu Shaoye was worried about. It lowered its head and smelled the ground, but did not smell the smell of other spiritual beasts.
High-level spiritual plants are usually surrounded by guardian spirit beasts, but the cold pool can cover the aura of the spirit beasts.
Shuangyue did not take it lightly. It paid attention to its surroundings and slowly walked onto the water.
Frost condensed under the feet, forming an icy path on the water as the footsteps moved.
Just when Shuangyue was halfway there, a huge black shadow slid under the ice. Shuangyue immediately lowered his head and looked over.
Just as it lowered its head, a black figure suddenly broke out of the water on the left side of the ice road, causing a wave of water more than five meters high.
Shuang Yue reacted quickly and formed a wall of ice to block the black shadow's attack.
Through the fluorescence of the Biguang Hanlian, the body of the black shadow appears. It has a slender body, gills on its cheeks, a smooth and scaleless body, and sharp webbed claws on its limbs.
